## Thesis

::: {.thesis-card}
<span class="pub-year">M.Sc.</span>

### Computational Methods for k-Parametric Dynamic Generalized Linear Models

Federal University of Rio de Janeiro (UFRJ). The dissertation develops computational methods for Bayesian dynamic models, from efficient sequential updating for k-DGLMs to extensions for multiple time series and the accompanying `kDGLM` software.
